wait-tools.ts.source_finding: Entire guidance/schema/parser/factory/execute body read through EOF in this continuation. Runtime installs the extension with catalog and max duration. Labels are catalog-backed; description, promptSnippet, schema descriptions, FLOW_WAIT_GUIDANCE and validation/refusal text are fixed English model instructions or local diagnostics. before_agent_start injects guidance through setPromptSections only when enabled and agent_wait is active. Execute normalizes optional fields, checks scope, resolves exact producer dependency/health policy, binds subscriptions, calls wait-store.declareOwned and rethrows after rollback on failure. Cancel checks the token and calls cancelOwned. Both return waitToolResponse; that helper's English framing/adjustment notices and preserved source reasons are content-hashed by the store and observed by ingress/wait-decisions. No custom call/result renderer is declared.
